rationale: FAMILY CONTRACT: cyclomatic complexity = 1 + decisions; decisions = if + for + ternary + && = 4, so f must be exactly 5. The previous per-method calculator had DEAD cases n.type === '&&'/'||' (&&/|| are operator fields inside binary_expression, not node types) so short-circuit operators never counted; the file-level counter also lacked the +1 base and missed enhanced_for and operators.
